meta.topic: 分數、等值分數、乘法和除法、百分數
meta.author: 小學數學（P4–P6）
meta.central_thesis: 分數表示一個整體的幾份；不同的分數可以表示同一個份量（等值分數）；一個配方乘以杯數就是大訂單的份量；百分數是以 100 為整體的分數。

zh: 金華冰室招學徒。
按住就倒，倒得準先叫師傅。
en: Kam Wah Café is hiring an apprentice.
Hold to pour. Pour it right and you're a master.

unit.zh: 按住按鈕就會倒，放手就停；輕輕一按只會倒一點點。杯上的線把一杯平均分成幾份。
unit.en: Hold a button to pour and let go to stop. A quick tap pours just a little. The lines on the glass split one cup into equal parts.

zh: 看杯上的線，用分數（例如 3/4 杯）倒出準確的份量。
認識三份、八份；知道 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8，在沒有對應刻度時估計份量。
把一杯的配方乘以杯數；用除法計算一定份量可以分成多少杯。
把百分數變成份量：正常甜的 50%、75%、25% 是多少 mL。
在時限內混合運用分數，又快又準地完成訂單。
en: Read the lines on a glass and pour an exact fraction, such as 3/4 cup.
Work with thirds and eighths, see that 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8, and estimate between marks.
Multiply a one-cup recipe by the number of cups, and divide to find how many cups an amount makes.
Turn a percentage into an amount: 50%, 75% or 25% of the normal syrup in mL.
Use fractions quickly and accurately to finish orders against the clock.

persona.zh: 冰室老師傅，沖了四十年奶茶
persona.en: Has been making milk tea at the café for forty years

persona.zh: 樓面姐姐，負責落單和送餐
persona.en: Takes the orders and carries the drinks

persona.zh: 另一個學徒，經常憑感覺亂倒
persona.en: Another apprentice who pours by guesswork

persona.zh: 每日來飲奶茶的熟客，一試就知道
persona.en: A regular who can taste any mistake

brief.zh: 杯上的線把一杯分成 4 份，每一份是 1/4 杯。看清楚單上要幾多份，按住按鈕倒到那條線。
brief.en: The lines split the glass into 4 equal parts, so each part is 1/4 cup. Read the order, then hold the button and pour up to the right line.

rival.zh: 1/2 杯？杯上面只有 1/4 的線，沒有 1/2 那條線，倒不到啦！
rival.en: 1/2 a cup? The glass only has quarter lines. There's no line for 1/2, so you can't pour it!

say.zh: 陳太要多奶：茶和淡奶各一半。杯上沒有 1/2 的線，你要自己想想是第幾條線。
say.en: Mrs Chan wants extra milk: half tea, half milk. There's no 1/2 line, so work out which quarter line it is.

zh: 由杯底數上去：第 1 條線是 1/4，第 2 條是 2/4，第 3 條是 3/4，杯口是 4/4，即是 1 杯。
1/2 和 2/4 是同一個份量，所以 1/2 杯就倒到第 2 條線。
倒第二樣材料時，要把兩樣加起來：先倒了 3/4 杯茶，再加 1/4 杯奶，就到杯口了。
en: Count up from the bottom: line 1 is 1/4, line 2 is 2/4, line 3 is 3/4, and the rim is 4/4, which is 1 whole cup.
1/2 and 2/4 are the same amount, so pour 1/2 a cup up to the second line.
When you add the second ingredient, add the amounts together: 3/4 cup of tea plus 1/4 cup of milk reaches the rim.

question.en: How many quarter cups make 1/2 a cup?

explain.en: 1/2 = 2/4, so half a cup is two quarter cups.

brief.zh: 今日換了新杯：有些杯分成 3 份，有些分成 8 份。分得越多份，每一份就越少。
brief.en: New glasses today: some are split into 3 parts, some into 8. The more parts a cup is split into, the smaller each part is.

rival.zh: 3 比 4 細，所以 1/3 杯一定比 1/4 杯少啦！
rival.en: 3 is smaller than 4, so 1/3 of a cup must be less than 1/4!

say.zh: 這隻杯分成 3 份。咖啡、茶、淡奶各 1/3 杯。留意每一份比 1/4 杯多。
say.en: This glass is split into 3 parts. Coffee, tea and milk, 1/3 cup each. Notice each part is more than 1/4 cup.

say.zh: 八分杯用完了，只剩分 4 份的舊杯！單上寫 3/8 杯茶：3/8 在哪兩條線之間？
say.en: We're out of eighths glasses. Only the old quarter glass is left! The order says 3/8 cup of tea. Which two lines is 3/8 between?

zh: 分母是一杯分成幾份，分子是倒了幾份。3/8 即是一杯分 8 份，倒 3 份。
茶 3/8，再加咖啡 3/8，合共 6/8 = 3/4，即是第 3 條線；最後加淡奶到杯口。
en: The bottom number is how many parts the cup is split into; the top number is how many parts you pour. 3/8 means split into 8, pour 3.
1/4 = 2/8 and 1/2 = 4/8, so 3/8 is exactly halfway between the 1/4 and 1/2 lines.
Tea 3/8 plus coffee 3/8 makes 6/8 = 3/4, which is the third line. Then top up with milk to the rim.

question.zh: 5/8 杯茶加 3/8 杯奶，合共多少杯？
question.en: 5/8 cup of tea plus 3/8 cup of milk. How much is that altogether?

explain.zh: 分母相同，分子相加：5/8 + 3/8 = 8/8 = 1 杯。分母不用相加。
explain.en: Same denominator, so add the tops: 5/8 + 3/8 = 8/8 = 1 cup. You don't add the bottoms.

brief.zh: 樓上寫字樓打電話來叫外賣奶茶！一杯奶茶的配方是茶 150 mL、淡奶 50 mL。用量杯一次過沖一大壺。
brief.en: The office upstairs is ordering takeaway milk tea! One cup takes 150 mL of tea and 50 mL of evaporated milk. Make one big jug for the whole order.

say.zh: 淡奶只剩 250 mL，每杯要 50 mL。最多可以沖幾杯？選好杯數就倒倒看。
say.en: Only 250 mL of evaporated milk is left, and each cup needs 50 mL. What's the most cups you can make? Pick a number and pour to see.

zh: 一杯要 150 mL 茶，4 杯就是 4 個 150 mL。
分淡奶：250 ÷ 50 = 5，所以最多 5 杯。
en: One cup needs 150 mL of tea, so 4 cups need four lots of 150 mL.
150 × 4 = 600 mL of tea and 50 × 4 = 200 mL of milk. After the tea, pour milk up to 600 + 200 = 800 mL.
Sharing the milk: 250 ÷ 50 = 5, so 5 cups at most.

question.zh: 一杯要 2 茶匙糖，8 杯要多少茶匙？
question.en: One cup needs 2 teaspoons of sugar. How many teaspoons for 8 cups?

explain.zh: 8 杯每杯 2 茶匙：2 × 8 = 16 茶匙。

brief.zh: 凍檸茶正常甜要 40 mL 糖水。客人會說「半甜」、「少甜」，即是正常份量的某個百分比。用量筒量出準確的糖水。
brief.en: A normal iced lemon tea takes 40 mL of syrup. When customers say “half sweet” or “less sweet”, they mean a percentage of the normal amount. Measure the syrup exactly in the measuring cylinder.

rival.zh: 少甜 75%？即係落 75 mL 糖水啦！
rival.en: Less sweet is 75%? So that's 75 mL of syrup!

say.zh: 大杯凍檸茶正常甜要 60 mL 糖水。客人要少甜，即是 75%。
say.en: A large iced lemon tea normally takes 60 mL of syrup. The customer wants it less sweet, which is 75%.

zh: 百分數是以 100 為整體：50% 是一半，25% 是四分一，75% 是四分三。
en: A percentage treats 100 as the whole: 50% is half, 25% is a quarter, 75% is three quarters.

question.zh: 正常甜要 40 mL 糖水，三分甜（30%）要多少 mL？
question.en: Normal sweetness takes 40 mL of syrup. How much for 30% sweet?

brief.zh: 十二點了，客人排長龍！在時間內沖好所有飲品，倒得越準、越快，分數越高。
brief.en: It's noon and the queue is out the door! Make every drink before time runs out. The more accurate and the faster, the higher your score.

rival.zh: 快啲快啲，求其倒滿一杯就算啦！
rival.en: Hurry, hurry! Just fill it to the top, close enough!

zh: 先看杯分成幾份，再看單上的分母是否一樣。
每倒一樣材料，就把份數加起來，看看要倒到哪條線。
en: First see how many parts the glass has, then check whether the order uses the same denominator.
If the denominators differ, change to equivalent fractions: 1/4 = 2/8 and 1/2 = 4/8.
After each ingredient, add up the parts so far to see which line to pour to next.

question.en: Which drink has the most tea?

explain.en: Use a common denominator of 24: 3/4 = 18/24, 2/3 = 16/24, 5/8 = 15/24, 1/2 = 12/24. So 3/4 cup is the most.

text.zh: 倒得準、計得快，陳太話你沖的奶茶同黃師傅一樣好飲。
text.en: Accurate pours and quick sums. Mrs Chan says your milk tea is as good as Master Wong's.

text.zh: 大部分飲品都沖得好，有些分數還要再練習。
text.en: Most drinks came out well. Some of the fractions need a bit more practice.

text.zh: 多看杯上的線，記住分母是分成幾份，下次一定更好。
text.en: Look carefully at the lines on the glass and remember the bottom number tells you how many parts. You'll do better next time.

debrief.zh: 分母是一個整體平均分成幾份，分子是取了幾份；1/2、2/4、4/8 是同一個份量；大訂單就是配方乘以杯數；百分數是以 100 為整體，50% 是一半、25% 是四分一。
debrief.en: The denominator is how many equal parts the whole is split into; the numerator is how many parts you take. 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 are the same amount. A big order is the recipe times the number of cups. A percentage treats 100 as the whole: 50% is half and 25% is a quarter.
